sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $8\mathrm{\ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Properties of rectangles, rhombuses, and squares
questions.answer: Final Answer: $16\mathrm{\ cm}$. Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $8 \times 2 = 16\mathrm{\ cm}$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $8 \times 2 = 16\mathrm{\ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 4$ passes through $(0, 8)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Properties of rectangles, rhombuses, and squares
questions.answer: Final Answer: $12$. Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 4x + 8$ gives $y = 4(1) + 8 = 12$.
questions.explanation: Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 4x + 8$ gives $y = 4(1) + 8 = 12$.

questions.q: In $\Delta  ABC$ studying properties of rectangles, rhombuses, and squares, $m\angle A = 34^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 52^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Properties of rectangles, rhombuses, and squares
questions.answer: Final Answer: $94^\circ$. Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (34^\circ + 52^\circ) = 94^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (34^\circ + 52^\circ) = 94^\circ$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 2x + 9$ in properties of trapezoids, evaluate $f(2)$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $13$. Substitute $x = 2$: $f(2) = 2(2) + 9 = 13$.

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 1$ and $x = 6$. Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 6) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 6$.
questions.explanation: Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 6) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 6$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for properties of trapezoids consists of the four values $\{11, 15, 19, 25\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $17.5$. The sum is $11 + 15 + 19 + 25 = 70$, and dividing by $4$ gives $17.5$.
questions.explanation: The sum is $11 + 15 + 19 + 25 = 70$, and dividing by $4$ gives $17.5$.
